environment: Disposable local authoring sandbox; Bash --noprofile --norc; minimal PATH and C locale; not a student VM
limits: Only owned temporary files and mode bits were exercised; no access-denial, cross-account or ACL test.
No supported guest/hypervisor/hardware, learner usability/accessibility, independent student performance, grader calibration, full-checkout checks or CI validation.

No privilege-escalation attempt, sudo, network, package installation or system-file modification. The effective-UID flag above describes this author sandbox, not a validated normal-account student session.
One extra instructor case demonstrates status preservation; this is not a claim the full interactive lessons ran.

cases.script:
printf '%s\n' 'authorized lab note' > 'scope note.txt'
cp -- 'scope note.txt' copy.txt
cmp -- 'scope note.txt' copy.txt
result=$?
printf 'comparison status=%s\n' "$result"
cat -- copy.txt

printf '%s\n' 'authorized lab note' > 'scope note.txt'
chmod u=rw,go= 'scope note.txt'
stat -c '%a %A' -- 'scope note.txt'
chmod u=r,go= 'scope note.txt'
stat -c '%a %A' -- 'scope note.txt'
cat -- 'scope note.txt'
chmod u=rw,go= 'scope note.txt'
stat -c '%a %A' -- 'scope note.txt'

printf '%s\n' 'authorized lab note' > copy.txt
ls -- copy.txt absent.txt > listing.txt 2> errors.txt
result=$?
printf 'status=%s\n' "$result"

printf '%s\n' first > stream.txt
printf '%s\n' second >> stream.txt
printf 'before:\n'
cat -- stream.txt
printf '%s\n' replacement > stream.txt
printf 'after:\n'
cat -- stream.txt

(
set +o pipefail
false | cat
printf 'default=%s\n' "$?"
set -o pipefail
false | cat
printf 'pipefail=%s\n' "$?"
)

ls -- absent.txt > ignored.txt 2> errors.txt
saved=$?
true
late=$?
printf 'saved=%s late=%s\n' "$saved" "$late"

toolchain_classification: Mixed GNU and uutils implementations; do not claim the prescribed GNU student environment was validated.
validation_kind: Six selected local command contracts, not student competency, full interactive lessons, guest/platform or release validation.
evidence_minimization: Captured listing and diagnostic content were checked; the stored extra observation retains only listing lines and diagnostic predicates, not a purported full guest transcript.
